visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female shop assistant with dark hair tied back and a light green mask is packing two cups of drinks into a clear plastic bag on a stainless steel counter. (2) Close-up shot of yellow-colored tea being poured into a tall paper cup decorated with fruit and leaf patterns. White foam forms on top of the liquid. (3) A thick, creamy white milk cap is being poured from a spout onto a dark tea base, creating a swirling layer on top. (4) A close-up of a plastic scoop placing thick, beige mung bean slush into a cup. (5) A man in a light-colored shirt and black mask lifts a large metal container and places it into a specialized spinning machine. (6) Close-up of tea being dispensed from a large green metallic tea canister into a silver shaker. (7) Ice cubes are scooped into a silver shaker. (8) Brown tea is poured from a shaker into a cup with ice. (9) More milk cap is poured into the cup. Cocoa powder is sprinkled on the surface of the thick foam. (10) A refreshing drink with ice cubes and a slice of lemon is shown. Honey is poured from a bottle into a small measuring cup. (11) A lime slice is placed on top of a bubbly drink with tweezers. (12) Fresh purple grapes are poured from a small cup into a blender. The 'blendtec' blender whirs as it mixes the grapes into a pinkish liquid. (13) A scoop of clear, jelly-like crystals is added to a pink-toned drink. (14) A hand is seen pressing the top of a blender as it processes a yellow liquid. (15) The final shot shows the storefront of '小良田' with a white sign and green logo, followed by a wide shot of the shop entrance at street level under an overcast sky.

(7) [Subtitle]: 冰沙綿密又充滿豆香. (8) [Subtitle]: 喜歡茶的話. (9) [Subtitle]: 一定要試試紅烏龍. (10) [Subtitle]: 茶香清爽不澀. (11) [Subtitle]: 無糖也好喝. (12) [Subtitle]: 加上厚厚的奶蓋. (13) [Subtitle]: 是用起司乳酪. (14) [Subtitle]: 煉乳和海鹽打製. (15) [Subtitle]: 綿密鹹甜有層次. (16) [Subtitle]: 果茶系列很推薦. (17) [Subtitle]: 蜂蜜青檸茶. (18) [Subtitle]: 酸酸甜甜的. (19) [Subtitle]: 加上薄荷茶的. (20) [Subtitle]: 微涼感. (21) [Subtitle]: 還有現刨檸檬皮.
